subject: Storage for paperwork and equipment
hook: Can our spare room be a home office and a guest room?
fb:
First Monday back, and a question we hear a lot in January: can our spare room be a home office and still work as a guest room?

Often, yes. The secret is closed storage. If the printer, files and work kit live behind doors and in drawers, you can clear the desk in five minutes when someone comes to stay.

A fitted desk along one wall keeps the floor free for the bed, and one cupboard section can stay empty for guests to hang their things.

Working out how it would fit in your room? Ask us, or arrange a free consultation:

gbp:
Can a spare room work as both a home office and a guest bedroom?

In many homes, yes. The key is closed storage. When files, the printer and work equipment live behind cupboard doors and in drawers, the room switches from office to guest room in minutes.

A fitted desk along one wall keeps floor space free for a bed, cable grommets keep chargers and the printer tidy, and one cupboard section can be left clear for guests' clothes. Shelving above can be open or closed, depending on how the room is used.

Everything is designed with you at a free, no-obligation consultation, priced in an itemised quote, built in our own Hanley workshop and installed by our own team. We work with homes across Stoke-on-Trent and Staffordshire.
